name: pyqg subgrid forcing and reference simulations dataset
resolution: 256x256 (3.9 km) highres and 64x64 (15.6 km) lowres, 2 vertical layers; domain 10^6 m x 10^6 m

scales.note: Idealized 2-layer quasi-geostrophic ocean model on a 1000 km periodic domain; high-res (256x256, dt=1 h) and low-res (64x64, dt=2 h) simulations run for 10 years.
